description:
Ask your assistant for a chart and it arrives in the conversation — scrub Bitcoin's week, set an A-to-B range, and see the move in numbers. Pull funding, open interest, liquidations and order-book depth. See hourly regime shifts. Compare whole sectors, like DeFi against AI tokens. Follow source-linked news and ticker video coverage, or read the latest published Market Update with its chapters.

Figures come from The Coin Daily's own research pipeline: widgets show the evidence that was read and leave missing readings visible as gaps. Editorial market commentary — not investment advice. No trading, wallet or payment features. Sign in with OAuth.

defaultPrompt: Show me Bitcoin's 7-day price using The Coin Daily.
What's The Coin Daily's read on the market today?
Compare DeFi tokens with AI-related crypto tokens over the past seven days.
